# Metrics

Served on `GET /metrics`, port 8080, in the OpenMetrics text format ([ADR-0010](../adr/0010-health-metrics-and-events.md)), generated from what `crates/notaio/src/metrics.rs` renders. Gauges are computed at scrape time; counters count since the process started. Scraping and alerting are in [Observe notaio](../guides/observability.md).

| Metric | Type | Labels | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `notaio_policies` | gauge | `reason` | Sandbox policies by the reason of their Ready condition. |
| `notaio_lint_failures` | gauge | `kind` | Objects failing lint now: profiles and policies with Valid false, rejected grants. |
| `notaio_relaxations` | gauge | `phase` | Knob grants (relaxations) by phase. |
| `notaio_relaxation_age_seconds` | gauge | `grant`, `namespace` | Age of each active relaxation. |
| `notaio_relaxation_expires_in_seconds` | gauge | `grant`, `namespace` | Time until each active relaxation expires. |
| `notaio_relaxations_past_expiry` | gauge |  | Active relaxations whose expiresAt has passed. Must be 0. |
| `notaio_bundle_age_seconds` | gauge | `namespace`, `policy` | Age of each policy's published bundle. |
| `notaio_bundle_expires_in_seconds` | gauge | `namespace`, `policy` | Time until each policy's published bundle passes notAfter. |
| `notaio_bundles_published_total` | counter |  | Bundles signed and published. |
| `notaio_signing_failures_total` | counter |  | Signing attempts that failed, so nothing was published. |
| `notaio_reconcile_errors_total` | counter |  | Reconciles that returned an error and were retried. |
| `notaio_fail_open_total` | counter | `check` | Publications refused because the bundle failed a check the evaluator should have made. Must be 0. |
